author: /root read-only research, GPT-6 Astra Ultra
purpose: Concrete next-scope design input for existing MATURE01 floating layer and MATURE02 TODO11 real host Quick consumption; not a new task or authority.

observations.fact: Trigger/current value/candidates/pending section render full model labels; variable catalogue precedes Apply/Cancel, whole dialog scrolls. Actual390 stress PNG demonstrates repeated180-character label and primary action initially below viewport.
observations.qualification: Current six group PASS remains; this is usability follow-up, not a claim that the whole production App was visually tested or failed.

observations.fact: Shared primitive has sm:rounded-lg; feature ep-dialog does not supply a narrow-screen radius. Existing --radius=.75rem plus radius scale/theme colors and shadow utility can be reused locally without redesigning unrelated dialogs.

Official Thread component has a ComposerActions seam already wired to chat.composer.actions. Recovery ConversationThread still renders old ExecutionProfilePicker in ComposerConfiguration; new MessageSettingsPicker has no real host consumer.
observations.qualification: Neither Thread replacement nor a second plugin host is needed. Existing registry and host-owned draft authority are the intended seams; actual precise claim depends on Recovery handback and Quick main intake.

proposedSmallDesign.trigger: Compact current model plus short thinking/speed summary. Preserve full accessible name and an explicit details disclosure usable with keyboard and touch. Do not rely only on hover/title or render opaque IDs on the primary row.
proposedSmallDesign.dialog: Retain Radix controlled modal and existing ownership lease. Header/current selection and Apply/Cancel footer remain outside a bounded scroll region for filters/catalogue; cap visual long-name height, allow full identity disclosure, and distinguish equal-prefix options using authorized profile identity in details. Footer must not overlap focused controls at zoom or small viewport.
proposedSmallDesign.state: One pending choice, existing exact authorized tuple projection and explicit Apply. Filtering does not commit; no invented crossproduct or automatic fallback. On unavailable/removed candidate preserve original draft, expose reason, revoke stale ownership, and retain existing return-focus rules.
proposedSmallDesign.extension: Reuse existing Thread ComposerActions/registry integration and original host CAS seam. A plugin may request UI opening through host-bound context; it does not own recovery authority or acquire arbitrary task IDs. Avoid parallel per-pane settings state or a second registry.

focusedAcceptance: Normal authorized model names AND long180-character stress labels, both light/dark at390; additionally equal-prefix distinct identities are distinguishable through disclosure.
Apply/Cancel discoverable on first view independent of catalogue length; body scroll never hides or overlaps focused radio or action; narrow/zoom layout has no horizontal clipping.
Keyboard focus remains trapped; Escape/Cancel no write, Apply one CAS commit, identity/view/draft change invalidates pending choice, details navigation returns focus to logical target.

Exact authorized32-tuple pagination and missing applied selection retain their prior assertions; do not repeat the entire old suite solely for metadata. New host checks target Send/Queue/Recovery frozen settings separately.

primarySources.used: Current documentation router confirms Thread, Composer and component composition are separate primitives/elements; existing installed code is the actual compatibility baseline. No package upgrade inferred.

Controlled Dialog, Title/Description, focus trapping, Escape and autofocus callbacks support keeping existing semantics while changing feature layout; current website version is not assumed installed.

Contain Tab navigation, choose initial focus according to content size, return to invoking or logical control, and expose a visible closing action. Long structured content should not become one giant announced description.

skillMethod.discovery: find-skills domain mapping with existing local skills first; no installation
skillMethod.application: Preserve actual Thread and deep host-owned settings interface; separate presentation from authorization and lifecycle, reuse registry, prioritize bounded UI and behavior checks.

notPerformed: No production App or deployment changes
